purpose: Bounded data-feasibility gate for a real candidate-role baseline; no training or quality claim yet
initial_action: Read at most 65536 trailing ZIP bytes per official object to verify HTTP range support, archive central directory size and stable object identity.
stop: Refuse non-206 range responses, changed ETag, unbounded reads, any access denial or total-budget excess. Do not download full archives or switch mirrors.
data_split_intent: Select native-page samples by immutable official document identity and dataset split, freeze selection/features before fit. Existing diagnostic papers excluded. Source-family overlap must be reported, never inferred absent.
measurement: All annotated objects form recall denominator, including missing/mixed candidate matches. Separate conditional role accuracy from end-to-end reflow. No formula-number relation claim from layout-only labels.
